thread.title: Deep Dive: Here are Tuesday’s biggest stock-market losers

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Deep Dive: Here are Tuesday’s biggest stock-market losers
text:
Trading in the U.S. stock market started on a sour note Tuesday, following disappointing earnings reports from two venerable industrial companies and a sell-off in Chinese markets.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average
 DJIA, -1.55%
 was down as much as 1.8% in early trading, while the S&P 500 Index
 SPX, -1.79%
 dropped as much as 1.7% and the Nasdaq Composite Index
 COMP, -2.22%
 fell as much as 2.1%. Those declines followed a reversal for China’s Shanghai Composite Index
 SHCOMP, -2.26%
 which was down 2.3% after a two-day rally.
U.S. investors didn’t react well to Caterpillar’s
 CAT, -7.79%
 third-quarter earnings report, which included much lower-than-expected earnings guidance for 2018 . They were similarly disappointed by 3M
 MMM, -6.95%
At about 9:45 a.m. ET, all but four of the 30 Dow stocks were down:
